purpose: SnapLogic evidence promotion and reusable managed-task ingress authority.

connectionRoutes.authentication: dedicated task bearer token in the Authorization header
connectionRoutes.notes: Preferred steady-state route where a customer already operates SnapLogic. Query-string bearer tokens are denied because they can leak through URLs and logs. The task contract, pipeline revision, parameters and WFM sink are exact and immutable.

connectionRoutes.direction: SnapLogic execution evidence to WFM reconciliation
connectionRoutes.authentication: dedicated API-only service account or JWT with read access to approved assets
connectionRoutes.notes: Retrieve one exact Runtime ID (RUUID) and its terminal status. Runtime start/stop, project migration, task/pipeline/account changes and other management APIs remain denied.

cloudplex.routing: SnapLogic-managed data plane using the exact customer control-plane region and approved task URL.

groundplex.routing: Customer-self-managed Snaplex inside the customer network or private cloud. WFM invokes only the approved task route and receives bounded output; it never receives Groundplex or source-network administration.

managedTaskIngressAuthority.receiptPolicy: Only an exact Completed RUUID with zero error documents, zero failed Snaps, matching task/pipeline/schema revisions and conflict-free record identities becomes a reconciliation candidate. It never directly advances a checkpoint or grants deletion authority.

stableIds: SnapLogic environment/org, project, task and pipeline asset identity
source-system stable record ID and source version retained by the approved pipeline
task/pipeline revision and output schema fingerprint
WFM tenant, connection and checkpoint namespace
patch.readCapability: Invoke one exact customer-owned read-projection Triggered Task and retrieve the matching execution status by RUUID. Source objects depend on the customer's installed Snap Packs and approved pipeline mapping.
patch.writeCapability: SnapLogic tasks and public APIs can execute arbitrary pipeline logic, accept mutation verbs, stop/resume executions and manage assets. WFM denies all source writes and management operations; HTTP GET/POST and successful authentication never prove read-only semantics.
patch.freshnessLatency: Triggered Tasks support request/response invocation and Ultra Tasks support low-latency processing. Record execution start/completion, source/effective time and WFM ingestion time separately; provider task status alone is not completeness evidence.
permissions: dedicated API-only service account or task bearer credential
read access only to exact approved monitoring assets
exact task URL and immutable read-only pipeline contract
no Environment admin, project Full Access or runtime control authority for steady-state WFM

paginationDeltaEventsFilesQueues.pagination: Paging is source Snap/pipeline specific. The pipeline must emit stable source IDs/versions and bounded output with explicit completion evidence; the RUUID does not prove every source page was read.
paginationDeltaEventsFilesQueues.delta: Delta/watermark logic is customer-pipeline specific. Bind the source window and task/pipeline revision to reconciliation and replay with overlap from the last WFM-committed checkpoint.
paginationDeltaEventsFilesQueues.events: Triggered and Ultra Tasks provide request/response or low-latency delivery, but Ultra Tasks have a documented duplicate-message failure mode. Treat delivery as at-least-once and deduplicate exact source ID + version + payload digest.
paginationDeltaEventsFilesQueues.files: File/SFTP outputs remain valid for backfills and small estates and enter through the existing batch-reconciliation contract.
paginationDeltaEventsFilesQueues.queues: FeedMaster/Ultra delivery is not assumed exactly-once. Exact duplicate records are collapsed; the same source identity/version with different payload digests is quarantined.

patch.customFields: Pipeline transforms, expressions, parameters, child pipelines, error pipelines and Snap versions are customer/environment specific. Preserve source field identity and local extensions, fingerprint output per pipeline revision, and quarantine authority-changing or incompatible drift.
patch.regionalApiVersions: SnapLogic documents US and EMEA control-plane hosts and region-bound credentials, plus UAT variants and control-plane migration for data residency. Pin the exact host/environment and require a new checkpoint namespace plus overlap reconciliation after any route or environment change.
patch.rateLimits: No universal limit is claimed across customer tasks, Snap Packs, source APIs and licensing. Bound concurrent invocations, runtime, output records/bytes and polling; use provider execution metrics where authorised without requiring Environment admin in steady state.
failureModes: bearer token passed in a query string and leaked through logs, history or proxies
task owner password expiry affecting cloud task execution
wrong environment/org, control plane, project, task, pipeline, Snaplex route or WFM tenant
task or pipeline revision changed without schema revalidation
pipeline accepts write verbs or performs hidden source/target mutations
task reports Completed while error documents or failed Snaps exist
Ultra/FeedMaster duplicate message delivery or overlapping instances after pipeline change
same source identity/version replayed with conflicting payload
runtime list query omits executions outside its time window
Groundplex, FeedMaster or source endpoint disconnect
credential expiry/revocation, permission change, throttling or regional outage
patch.reconciliation: Bind each invocation to an exact immutable plan and one RUUID. Admit only Completed, revision/schema-matching executions with zero error documents and failed Snaps. Collapse exact replays by source ID + source version + payload digest, but quarantine any conflicting duplicate identity. The result is only a candidate for the existing reconciliation layer; no task receipt directly advances a checkpoint or creates deletion authority.
patch.schemaDrift: Fingerprint the output schema and task/pipeline revisions. Additive approved fields retain provenance; removed/type-changed IDs, new sensitive fields, changed units/currencies/timezones, modified parameters, child/error-pipeline changes or Snap-version drift quarantine the dataset.
patch.retriesReconnect: 401/403 stops for credential/permission diagnosis; 429/5xx/network failures use bounded backoff without changing region or task. Retry from the last WFM-committed checkpoint with overlap and stable identity dedupe. A new RUUID or provider retry does not imply a new business record or permit checkpoint advancement.
patch.evidenceNote: SnapLogic documentation reviewed 26 September 2026 establishes Triggered/Ultra task invocation, bearer authentication, task-owner execution, Runtime IDs and statuses, US/EMEA control-plane hosts, Cloudplex/Groundplex variants, project permissions and the documented Ultra duplicate-message issue. No sandbox or customer tenant was authenticated and no live task or source read round-trip was performed.
securityEvidenceBlockers: A Triggered Task can use POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE and runs as its owner, so tenant proof must inspect the exact pipeline and source/target accounts rather than infer safety from the HTTP method.
Anyone with a task bearer token can execute the task; WFM requires header-only transport, rotation/revocation proof and secret-free evidence.
The Runtime API exposes start/stop operations alongside reads; steady-state credentials must prove denied runtime control and asset management.
Groundplex network placement, region binding, source paging/delta behavior and error-pipeline completeness require authorised tenant discovery.

savingsHypotheses: reduce integration implementation effort by reusing one governed customer pipeline
reduce overtime and paid idle time by joining workforce capacity with production/material constraints
reduce reconciliation effort by collapsing exact replays and quarantining identity conflicts before checkpoints move
automationOpportunities: discover a customer-approved task contract and propose canonical mappings without acquiring pipeline administration
reuse existing ERP/HCM/MES/maintenance/quality/finance pipelines for WFM semantic ingestion
monitor exact RUUID freshness and failure evidence, replaying safely after partial or duplicate delivery
constraintsRisks: installed Snap Packs and pipeline logic vary by customer
task owner authority can exceed WFM needs
Ultra delivery is not assumed exactly-once
documentation proof is not live tenant proof

patch.causalOutcomeReadiness: Preserve environment/org, project, task, pipeline and RUUID identity; source record/version, task/pipeline/schema revisions, source/effective/observation/ingestion times, recommendation/action IDs, baseline/outcome windows and competing schedule/material/machine/quality/finance changes.
patch.nextBuildAction: Use an authorised SnapLogic non-production environment to create one dedicated API-only service account and one exact read-only Triggered Task; prove header-only credential use, denied task/pipeline/runtime-control operations, US/EMEA and Cloudplex/Groundplex route binding, real source paging/delta output, RUUID monitoring, task-owner expiry, duplicate/conflicting Ultra delivery, schema drift and complete reconciliation without production, payroll or source mutation.
